name: improvement
description: Find and make improvements to anything, from one method to a whole feature. find ranks evidence-cited candidates by value-to-effort and hands the pick to planning; improve ships one improvement, measured against the repo's standards and, when the focus asks for it, current upstream guidance, as one small draft PR. Both run unattended on a schedule.

churn_window.title: Churn window
churn_window.description: Your git log --since window for the hotspot recipe, such as 90 days ago. A repository's docs/conventions/improvement.yaml overrides it. Unset: 90 days ago.

churn_exclude.title: Churn exclusions
churn_exclude.description: Extra ERE patterns, one per entry, left out of churn counting in every repository. Unioned with the repository's own patterns.

churn_exclude_defaults.title: Exclude mechanical files from churn
churn_exclude_defaults.description: false drops the lockfiles, generated output, snapshots and vendored trees resolved from each repository, leaving only declared patterns. Unset: true.

find_open_item_cap.title: Open item cap
find_open_item_cap.description: Lowers the cap on open items per source label that unattended /improvement:find files under. Applies only when below the repository's cap. 0 stops unattended filing.

find_run_item_cap.title: Items filed per unattended run
find_run_item_cap.description: Where the adaptive per-run filing cap starts. Unset: 3.

find_run_item_cap_floor.title: Per-run filing cap floor
find_run_item_cap_floor.description: Lowest value the per-run filing cap adapts to. Unset: 1.

find_run_item_cap_ceiling.title: Per-run filing cap ceiling
find_run_item_cap_ceiling.description: Highest value the per-run filing cap adapts to. Unset: 5.

find_size_band.title: Unattended size band
find_size_band.description: Candidate sizes an unattended run ranks: all, small, medium or large. Unset: all.

find_scope.title: Unattended scope
find_scope.description: What an unattended run scans: repo, or a target /improvement:find accepts. Unset: repo.

find_suppress_dismissed.title: Suppress dismissed candidates
find_suppress_dismissed.description: Whether an unattended run leaves out candidates an operator dismissed before. Unset: true.

evidence_sources_file.title: Evidence sources file
evidence_sources_file.description: A YAML file of yours whose evidence_sources key declares Tier 2 telemetry sources (MCP server, kind, scope, hints) for every repository. A repository's own declarations merge over it per source name.
